title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social activities and public spaces on and around the Cedarville University campus that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: ALT Nights
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide social events
cards.notes: Attend these free student-led events featuring movies, tournaments, and inflatables. They are held five times a year to build community.
cards.short_summary: Free campus social events with movies and games.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedarville's ALT Nights are free events aimed at building campus community through a wide range of engaging activities including movies and tournaments.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open to all current students; typically held in the evening at various campus locations.

cards.title: Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: 18-hole campus course
cards.notes: Play a round on this 18-hole course that winds through campus and cross-country fields. It is free for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: An 18-hole disc golf course free for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The university features an 18-hole disc golf course that is free to play for students and the general public.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University - UDisc Disc Golf Course Directory
cards.access_notes: Open daily; players must bring their own discs. Public is welcome if respectful.

cards.title: Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: 36-foot indoor challenge
cards.notes: Challenge yourself on the 36-foot indoor climbing wall located in the Fitness Center. Access is free for all current students.
cards.short_summary: Free indoor rock climbing for Cedarville students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center includes a 36-foot indoor climbing wall available for student use at no additional cost.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid student ID for entry during recreation center hours.

cards.title: Centennial Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet study and free mints
cards.notes: Utilize quiet study zones and group rooms in the library. Don't forget to grab a free mint from the front counter.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering free study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centennial Library provides numerous group tables and 9 reservable group study rooms for student use without charge.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public; group rooms require reservation via LibCal.

cards.title: Indian Mound Reserve
cards.subtitle: Hiking and waterfalls
cards.notes: Explore eight different hiking trails and view Cedar Cliff Falls at this free park located just minutes from campus.
cards.short_summary: A free nature reserve with trails and a waterfall.
cards.evidence_claim: Indian Mound Reserve is free to visit and offers 8 hiking trails, including the popular Rim Trail and Cedar Cliff Falls.
cards.source_title: Indian Mound Reserve - Greene County Parks & Trails
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; located about a 4-minute drive from campus.

cards.title: Racquetball Courts
cards.subtitle: Free equipment and court time
cards.notes: Reserve a court in the Fitness Center for a match. Rackets and balls are provided at no charge for student use.
cards.short_summary: Free racquetball court use and equipment rental.
cards.evidence_claim: The university's racquetball courts provide opportunities for competition, with rackets and balls available at no charge.
cards.access_notes: Available during Fitness Center hours; equipment can be checked out at the desk.

cards.title: Campus Hammocking
cards.subtitle: Outdoor relaxation spots
cards.notes: Hang your hammock on the Engineering and Science Building hillside or in Maddox's backyard for a free outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: Popular free outdoor relaxation activity on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Students frequently use trees across campus, specifically at the ENS hillside and Maddox backyard, for hammocking.
cards.source_title: 5 Fun Activities to Fill 50 Free Minutes - Student Life Blog
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor spaces; students must provide their own hammocks.

cards.title: SSC Game Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level student hangout
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of the Stevens Student Center to use the game room or borrow board games from the information desk.
cards.short_summary: Free game room and board game rentals in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stevens Student Center (SSC) offers a game room in the lower level and board game loans at the upper information desk.
cards.access_notes: Open during SSC building hours; board games require a student ID for checkout.

cards.title: Cedarville Community Park
cards.subtitle: Village green space
cards.notes: Walk 10 minutes from campus to this park for baseball diamonds, playgrounds, and open space for yard games.
cards.short_summary: A local village park free for student and public use.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedarville's community park is within short walking distance from campus and offers baseball diamonds and grassy areas for games.
cards.source_title: 5 Things to do in Cedarville Without a Car - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Athletic Events
cards.subtitle: NCAA Division II home games
cards.notes: Cheer on the Yellow Jackets at home games for basketball, soccer, and volleyball. Admission is free for all current students.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to home sporting events for students.
cards.evidence_claim: There are many NCAA Division II athletic events to attend throughout the year, all free for students.
cards.source_title: What Do Cedarville Students Do For Fun?
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid student ID for free entry to regular season home games.
